Method of Attack: SQL injection vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to gain access and execute arbitrary code remotely
Abuse of SQL injection to obtain sysadmin API access token and abuse deserialization call for remote code execution
Impacted Systems: MOVEit Transfer managed file transfer (MFT) solution
Attack Vector: Exploitation of SQL injection vulnerability on unpatched MOVEit servers exposed to Internet
Indicators of Compromise: List of indicators of compromise (IOCs) published by Horizon3
